policy_statements.source_text: This Departmental Regulation (DR) maintains the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Chief Information Officers (CIO) Council as a permanently chartered committee.
This DR defines the CIO Council’s scope, authority, membership, and voting guidelines.
This policy applies to all USDA Mission Areas, agencies, staff offices, employees, and contractors working for, or on behalf of, USDA.
policy_statements.target: all USDA Mission Areas, agencies, staff offices, employees, and contractors working for, or on behalf of, USDA

policy_statements.source_text: This DR supersedes DR 3105-001, USDA Chief Information Officers Council, dated April 6, 2016.
This DR is effective as of the publication date.
It will remain in effect until superseded or expiration.
Nothing in this DR supplants the delegation of authorities and responsibilities of the USDA CIO under 7 Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) § 2.32, Chief Information Officer.

Also, nothing in this DR supplants the delegation of authorities and responsibilities of the USDA CIO under any other authorities otherwise provided by law, Federal regulation, or USDA Departmental directive.
The CIO Council’s bylaws set out the operating procedures of the CIO Council.
A current copy of these bylaws, Bylaws of the United States Department of Agriculture Chief Information Officers Council, appears on the CIO Council’s shared site.
cross_references: Bylaws of the United States Department of Agriculture Chief Information Officers Council

policy_statements.source_text: IT policies the USDA CIO deems relevant to the CIO Council.
The CIO Council serves as one of the principal USDA IT advisory forums of the USDA CIO.
policy_statements.target: one of the principal USDA IT advisory forums of the USDA CIO

policy_statements.source_text: Its purpose is to improve the operational efficiency and strategic use of IT across the USDA enterprise.
policy_statements.target: the operational efficiency and strategic use of IT across the USDA enterprise

policy_statements.source_text: The CIO Council advises the USDA CIO on the technical and managerial soundness of the Department’s IT initiatives, policies, procedures, and standards.
policy_statements.target: the USDA CIO on the technical and managerial soundness of the Department’s IT initiatives, policies, procedures, and standards

policy_statements.source_text: The CIO Council identifies opportunities to share information resources.
It assesses the needs of the Department’s IT workforce.
policy_statements.target: the needs of the Department’s IT workforce

policy_statements.source_text: It serves as a focal point for coordinating responses to Departmentwide IT challenges.
policy_statements.target: a focal point for coordinating responses to Departmentwide IT challenges

policy_statements.source_text: It partners with other governmental councils to address issues and risks that require multidisciplinary and multilevel solutions.
policy_statements.target: other governmental councils to address issues and risks that require multidisciplinary and multilevel solutions

policy_statements.source_text: The CIO Council advises the USDA CIO on IT matters that may become IT investments, as defined by DR 3130-013, Information Technology Capital Planning and Investment Control.
policy_statements.target: the USDA CIO on IT matters that may become IT investments, as defined by DR 3130-013, Information Technology Capital Planning and Investment Control
cross_references: DR 3130-013, Information Technology Capital Planning and Investment Control

policy_statements.source_text: IT initiatives that the CIO Council designates as enterprise initiatives will remain subject to, and will conform to, DR 3130-010, United States Department of Agriculture Enterprise Information Technology Governance, throughout their life cycle.
policy_statements.target: DR 3130-010, United States Department of Agriculture Enterprise Information Technology Governance
conditions: that the CIO Council designates as enterprise initiatives
cross_references: DR 3130-010, United States Department of Agriculture Enterprise Information Technology Governance

policy_statements.source_text: The USDA CIO will:
Preside over the CIO Council;
Appoint the OCIO Executive Secretariat; and
Serve as a voting member.
The Deputy CIO will serve as a CIO Council voting member.
Mission Area Assistant CIOs will serve as CIO Council voting members.
The Director of IT, Office of the Inspector General, will serve as a CIO Council voting member.
policy_statements.actor_name: Director of IT, Office of the Inspector General

policy_statements.source_text: Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) Associate CIOs (ACIO) will serve as CIO Council advisory (non-voting) members.
policy_statements.actor_name: Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) Associate CIOs (ACIO)

policy_statements.source_text: OCIO Division Officers will serve as CIO Council advisory (non-voting) members.
The OCIO Executive Secretariat, appointed by the USDA CIO, will serve as a CIO Council advisory (non-voting) member.
USDA Mission Areas, agencies, and staff offices can direct questions and inquiries regarding this DR via email to sm.ocio.cio.feedback@usda.gov.
